lines.text: IN TUNE WITH WELL-BEING:
A Full-Spectrum Wellness Journey
Join us for In Tune With Well-Being: A Full-Spectrum Wellness
Journey, a dynamic event designed to enhance your physical,
mental, and emotional well-being, on Thursday, November 16
from 10 A.M. to 4 P.M. at the Rowancourt University
Community Center.
Discover a range of activities including a restorative yoga session
led by renowned instructor Lucas Gyeon, a mindfulness meditation
workshop guided by Dr. Elara Mondragón, and a nutrition
discussion featuring holistic health coach Jamie Khoa.
Engage in a thought-provoking panel discussion on the intersection
of mental health and academic success with faculty members from
the Department of Psychology.
Connect with health-conscious peers at our afternoon social,
featuring live acoustic music by local students.
Admission is free for all students and faculty.
Preregistration is encouraged, but walk-ins are welcome!
RSVP at wellness.rowancourt.edu.
For more information, contact the Wellness Council at
wellness@rowancourt.edu or visit our website.
